name: check_recalls
description: Look up open safety recalls for a vehicle in the Transport Canada recall database, by make, model and model year. This is the ONLY source of recall information you may use — never describe a recall the caller mentions unless this tool returned it. Returns the total count plus up to five most recent recalls, each with a recall number, date, affected component and a summary. Set lang to the language the caller is speaking right now so the component and summary come back in that language.

make.description: Vehicle make, e.g. HONDA, TOYOTA, FORD. Uppercase where possible.

model.description: Vehicle model, e.g. CIVIC, COROLLA, F-150. Uppercase where possible.

lang.description: Language of the recall text to return. Use "fr" when the caller is speaking French, "en" when they are speaking English.
